exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) via induction of labor
cohort: Theoretical cohort of 6000 women with a prior CD and current stillbirth at 34-41 weeks' gestation
finding: Induction of labor for TOLAC in the setting of a stillbirth with a history of prior CD was found to be cost-effective compared to repeat CD, resulting in decreased costs and increased QALYs.
mod_finding: For women with a prior cesarean delivery and experiencing a stillbirth near term, induction of labor for a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) was found to be a more cost-effective strategy compared to a repeat cesarean delivery.
